name: VESPER
subtitle: Eclipse Reaper
desc: Mid-range polearm fighter. Throws crescent cuts from range, then rift-walks behind you.

talk.say: The sun sets on everyone. Tonight, you.
talk.re: Keep shining. It makes the dark easier to find.

name: Neon Shrine Rooftop
subtitle: Night stage
desc: A shrine gate on top of a skyscraper, city glowing below, petals blowing through the wires.

name: Iron Gauntlet
subtitle: Tough 3 vs 3 · big gem payout
desc: A harder team match. The enemy squad has more health, hits harder and fights on hard CPU. You start with your ultimate ready.

name: Eclipse Festival
subtitle: Vesper rate up
desc: Gem banner that puts Vesper in the rate-up slots.

name: KAZURO
subtitle: Thunder Ronin
desc: Fast katana duelist. Steps through you with a lightning cut, then finishes with a rising crescent.

talk.say: One cut. That is all I need.
talk.re: Then draw, and be quick about it.

name: MIRELLA
subtitle: Tide Dancer
desc: Light on her feet. Spinning kicks into a water cyclone that carries you across the stage.

talk.say: Try to keep up with the current.
talk.re: Oh, I love a partner with rhythm.

name: DRAVEN
subtitle: Ash Brawler
desc: Heavy hitter. Charges in with a rush, launches with an uppercut and never backs off.

name: SOLENNE
subtitle: Dawn Lancer
desc: Long reach with a holy spear. Pokes from range and punishes anyone who jumps in.

talk.say: Stand in the light and be measured.
talk.re: Your shadow is longer than your courage.

name: TORIK
subtitle: Stone Warden
desc: Slow and tough. Shakes the ground with a quake, then barrels through with a charge.

talk.re: Push, then. I have all day.

name: NYXIA
subtitle: Void Witch
desc: Zoner. Pulls you in with a gravity grip and bursts you with a floating orb.

talk.say: Come closer. The void is curious.

name: BRAMOS
subtitle: Iron Engine
desc: Mecha bruiser. A rocket rush up close and a ground quake to stop anyone running.

name: ZEPHRA
subtitle: Gale Archer
desc: Keeps you out with fast arrows and a rain of shots from above.

talk.re: The wind already told me your next step.

name: ONIKAI
subtitle: Blood Oni
desc: Dual daggers and blinks. Teleports behind you and fans blades in your back.

talk.say: I can smell your fear from here.
talk.re: Good. Fight like you mean it.

name: LUMEIRA
subtitle: Moon Priestess
desc: Calm staff fighter. A lance thrust up close and a moon orb that holds you in place.

talk.say: The moon watches. Be at peace.
talk.re: Your anger is loud. I will quiet it.

name: Featured Gacha Tab
subtitle: New first tab in the Gacha
desc: Adds a FEATURED tab as the first tab in the Gacha. Every fighter you release gets a rate-up banner there, released banners go there too, and it keeps the newest 8.

name: Story Chapter 1
subtitle: 100 quests with anime cutscenes
desc: Unlocks STORY on the main menu. Chapter 1, The Fallen Star: 100 quests in 10 parts, story quests and fights, each with a 3 minute cutscene that plays by itself with speech bubbles, camera cuts and music.

name: Lobby Music
subtitle: Upbeat anime theme in the menus
desc: Plays an upbeat anime style theme on the title screen and in every menu.

name: Map Music
subtitle: Every stage has its own track
desc: Each stage plays its own music during a match, with a different key, speed and mood for every map.

name: Summon Music
subtitle: Fast track for the summon scene
desc: Plays a fast, dramatic track during the summon cutscene.

name: Gacha Music
subtitle: Sparkly theme in the Gacha
desc: Plays its own light, sparkly theme while you are in the Gacha.

name: Story: No Long Waits
subtitle: Lines come one after another
desc: Cuts the long quiet parts in story scenes where the characters stand and wait before they talk.

name: Fighter Voices
subtitle: Fighters talk out loud
desc: Every fighter speaks their lines out loud: at the start of a match, when they use their ultimate, when they win and when they get knocked out. Your lead fighter also talks during the summon animation.

name: Challenges
subtitle: Daily, weekly and monthly
desc: Adds CHALLENGES to the main menu: 20 daily, 20 weekly and 20 monthly challenges. Each one pays yellow tickets and gems when you claim it.

name: Leaderboard
subtitle: Ranked, wins, raids and level
desc: Adds LEADERBOARD to the main menu with four boards: ranked points, total wins, boss raid clears and player level.

name: Sculpted Bodies
subtitle: New look for every fighter
desc: Every fighter has a more human body: a shaped chest and waist, muscled arms and legs, hands with fingers, and real feet.

name: Lobby: No Icon
subtitle: Removes the top left icon
desc: Takes the game icon out of the top left corner of the lobby.

name: Story: Side Arrows
subtitle: Quest page arrows on the sides
desc: Moves the arrows that flip the story quest pages to the middle of the left and right sides of the screen.

name: Detailed Weapons
subtitle: Sharper swords, staffs, bows and more
desc: Every weapon is redrawn with more detail: blades with edges and guards, wrapped grips, glowing staff heads, banded bo staffs, recurve bows and orbiting rings on orbs.

name: Victory Pose
subtitle: Winner poses before the result
desc: After the winner says their line to the loser, the camera zooms in on the winner while they strike a pose, and then VICTORY or DEFEAT shows.

name: Detailed Hair
subtitle: Strands, shine and layers
desc: Hair has more detail: separate strands, extra shine, layered locks at the back and side locks by the face.

name: Hair and Cloth Physics
subtitle: Hair and clothes move with the fighter
desc: Hair, capes, sashes and coat tails swing, bounce and lift as fighters run, jump, fall and get hit.

name: Unique Stances and Poses
subtitle: Every fighter stands their own way
desc: Every fighter has their own idle stance and their own win pose instead of sharing a handful.

name: Detailed Maps
subtitle: More to see on every stage
desc: Stages have more detail: light rays, birds or shooting stars, haze on the horizon, extra props like stone lanterns, street lamps, ice crystals, lava rocks and flags, and cracks and shine on the floor.

name: Cutscenes: Shadow Only
subtitle: Dark shadow in front, no double
desc: In cutscene shots filmed from behind a character, the big dark shadow in the front stays, and the character it belongs to is no longer also shown in the scene.

name: Lobby Icon Glitch Fix
subtitle: Stops the icon flashing in the corner
desc: Fixes the game icon flashing through at the top left of the screen.

name: Challenges: Side Arrows
subtitle: Page arrows on the sides
desc: Moves the arrows that flip the challenge pages to the middle of the left and right sides and removes the ones at the bottom.

name: Cinematic Ultimates
subtitle: Bigger, flashier ultimates
desc: Every ultimate has a longer cut-in with colour slashes, lightning, a scrolling name banner and a flash, plus energy rings and rising sparks during the move and a huge burst on the final hit.

name: Cutscenes: Real Back View
subtitle: The front shadow is the fighter's back
desc: In cutscene shots filmed from behind a character, the dark shape in the front is now drawn as that fighter's back: their hair, headband, shoulders and clothes.

name: 2.5D Fighters
subtitle: Three-quarter angle with depth
desc: Fighters are turned toward the camera so you see the chest and both shoulders, with light, shadow and shine that make their bodies look rounded. Uses the sculpted bodies.

name: Cutscenes: Face the Camera
subtitle: The other fighter looks at you
desc: In cutscene shots filmed from behind a character, the other fighter is drawn from the front, looking straight out of the screen.

name: Winner Faces the Camera
subtitle: Full body, looking right at you
desc: When a match ends, the camera goes straight to the winner's whole body from the front. They raise a fist, look at the camera and say their win line, and then VICTORY or DEFEAT shows. The part where the two fighters talk to each other is gone.

name: Cel-Shaded Fighters
subtitle: Hard anime shading and more detail
desc: Fighters are cel shaded like an anime: hard-edged shadows and bright shine on arms, legs, chest, face and hair, plus extra detail such as clothing folds, seams, buttons and trouser stripes.

name: Body Faces the Screen
subtitle: Chest toward you, wide stance
desc: Fighters stand the way they do in big anime fighting games: chest and both shoulders turned toward the screen in a wide stance, head still looking at the opponent, so you can see the detail on their body.

name: Whole Body Faces the Screen
subtitle: Hips, legs, feet and both arms too
desc: The whole body is turned toward the screen, not just the chest: hips drawn from the front, legs set wide with kneecaps showing, feet pointing outward, and both arms in front of the body. The head still looks at the opponent.

name: Story Voices
subtitle: Every story line is spoken
desc: All 100 story quests are voice acted. Each character speaks their lines out loud in the story scenes, and the narrator reads the scene openings. Uses the Sound setting for volume.

name: Cutscenes: Full Screen and Speed
subtitle: No bars, Skip and x1 x2 x3
desc: Story cutscenes fill the whole screen. The quest name and timer at the top and the tap to go faster line are gone. At the top right there is a Skip button and a speed button that switches between x1, x2 and x3.

name: Cutscenes: Talk Box at the Bottom
subtitle: Face square with the words next to it
desc: Story speech no longer pops up in bubbles. Everything is said in one box at the bottom of the screen: a square with the speaker's face, their name, and the words next to it.

name: Japanese Voices
subtitle: Switch fighter voices to Japanese
desc: Every fighter line is also recorded in Japanese: intro, ultimate, win, KO and summon lines. Configure gets a new VOICES button that switches between English and Japanese. The words on screen stay in English.

name: Japanese Subtitles
subtitle: Switch fighter subtitles to Japanese
desc: Configure gets a new SUBTITLES button that switches between English and Japanese. On Japanese, the words fighters say at the start of a match, when they win, when they are knocked out and in the summon scene are shown in Japanese.

name: Leaderboard: Icons and Banners
subtitle: Profile icon and banner with every name
desc: Every row on the leaderboard now shows the player's profile icon and their banner behind their name.

name: Leaderboard: Side Arrows
subtitle: Page arrows at the middle left and right
desc: The leaderboard page arrows are now big arrows at the middle left and middle right of the screen.

name: Voices Finish Their Lines
subtitle: Lines wait for the voice
desc: A fighter's line now stays on screen until the voice has finished saying it, in English and in Japanese, and the words type out in time with the voice.

name: Japanese Story Subtitles
subtitle: Story lines in Japanese
desc: All 1,329 story lines are translated to Japanese. When SUBTITLES is set to Japanese in Configure, the story cutscenes show their lines in Japanese. Story voices stay in English.

name: Leaderboard: Level and Rank
subtitle: Every row shows level and rank
desc: Every row on the leaderboard now also shows the player's level and their rank.

name: Profile: Ranked Wins and Most Used Team
subtitle: And other players can open your profile
desc: Your profile shows your ranked wins and your most used team. Other players can open your profile from the friends screen and the end of an online match to see them, with each fighter's level and stars. Ranked wins and team use are counted from when this update is on.

name: Online Match End Screen
subtitle: Both profiles, VS, add friend
desc: The end of an online match shows your profile and your opponent's with VS between, VICTORY or DEFEAT, PLAY AGAIN and LEAVE. You can send your opponent a friend request, and it says if they are online or offline.

name: 300 Bots
subtitle: Every bot has a name and a full profile
desc: There are now 300 bots in total, each with its own name and profile. They are the bots you meet online and the bots on the leaderboard.

name: Add Friends From a Profile
subtitle: And a check mark when already added
desc: When you open another player's profile there is an ADD FRIEND button. If you already added them, it shows a check mark and ADDED instead, on the profile, the end of match screen and the player search.

name: Leaderboard: Tap to View Profile
subtitle: Tap a player to open their profile
desc: Tap any player on the leaderboard to open their profile.

name: Leaderboard: Icon Borders
subtitle: Icons show each player's border
desc: Leaderboard icons now show each player's icon border. Bots use every kind of border.

name: Find More Players
subtitle: More players show up in friend search
desc: Friend search now finds more players. Send them a request and they may accept it or ignore it.

name: Gacha: Hold for Stats
subtitle: Hold a featured fighter to see their stats
desc: In the gacha, hold a featured fighter to open their stats. The stats screen has a TEST button for a free practice match.

name: Mailbox Pictures
subtitle: Fighters, maps and banners show a picture
desc: Mailbox news about a new fighter, map or banner now shows a picture of it.

name: Anime Cutscenes
subtitle: Story scenes act like an anime
desc: Same lines and voices. Characters stand relaxed instead of in a fight stance, turn to the camera or turn their back, walk in from and out to the background, and react to each line: blushing, sweat drops, anger marks, gloom, tears, question marks and music notes. Heated lines break into short fight exchanges between the lines.

name: Mood Music
subtitle: Cutscene music and sounds follow the mood
desc: The story music changes with the mood of the lines: happy, funny, sad, serious and fight themes, with a small sound cue when the mood shifts.

name: Story Places
subtitle: Story scenes get their own places
desc: Story quests are set in places that are not part of the map: camp, market, road, woods, ruins, docks, a dojo, an inn or a cave, with people passing in the background, night and dawn light, and one walk to a second place in the middle of longer scenes.

name: Battle Scars on Victory
subtitle: Cuts and blood stay on the winner
desc: The cuts, bruises and blood your fighter took in the match stay on them in the victory shot while they talk.

name: Mailbox Fighter Stats
subtitle: Tap fighter news to expand it
desc: Mailbox news about a new fighter or a banner can be tapped to expand. The expanded mail shows every fighter in it with their stats: rarity, type, skills, ultimate, stars and level.

name: Front and Back Angles in Matches
subtitle: Ultimates, intro close-ups and win poses
desc: On an ultimate the fighter is seen from behind winding up, then turns to face the camera, and the face in the cut-in turns to the front too. Match intro close-ups show the fighter from the front, and a fighter in their win pose faces the camera.

name: Extra Story Lines
subtitle: 3 new voiced lines in every story quest
desc: Each of the 40 story quests ends with three new lines, 120 in all, voiced in English by the same voices.

name: Fight Shouts and Pain Sounds
subtitle: Every fighter shouts, grunts and screams
desc: Fighters shout when they attack, grunt and scream when they are hit, and groan when they are knocked down. Plays in every match, in story fights and in cutscene fight exchanges.

name: Anime Fight Sound Effects
subtitle: Punches, blades, skills and ultimates
desc: New fight sounds: punches thud and crack, blades ring, heavy hits get a sharp ring, skills and shots sound like their element, and guard, dash, jump, ultimate and KO sounds are fuller.

name: Unique Skill and Ultimate Looks
subtitle: Every fighter's moves look like their own
desc: Skills and ultimates now show each fighter's element: lightning, fire, ice, shadow, stone, stars, wind, void, water, blossoms, wild or holy light, in their own colours with a pattern unique to that fighter.

name: Mailbox Arrows
subtitle: Page arrows at the middle left and right
desc: The mailbox page arrows now sit at the middle left and right of the screen, with the page number at the bottom.

name: Unique Moves
subtitle: Every fighter's skills and ultimate play differently
desc: Each fighter now has their own version of their two skills and ultimate: different cooldown and power, number of hits, reach and knockback, shot speed and size, and how the ultimate splits its damage between the flurry and the finisher.

name: Delete Read Mail
subtitle: Trash can on mail you have read
desc: After you read a mail or claim its gift, a trash can button appears on it. Tap it to delete that mail from your mailbox.

name: New Game Icon
subtitle: Kenko, facing forward
desc: The game icon is now Kenko facing forward with her hands together in front, in the lobby, on the browser tab and when the game is added to a home screen.

name: Treyyverse Studio Intro
subtitle: Plays before the start menu
desc: The 5-second Treyyverse studio intro plays each time the game is opened, before the start menu.

name: New Start Screen
subtitle: Kenko and Neto clash under the name
desc: The start screen now shows COMBO at the top with Kenko and Neto clashing under it. The picture is still and the line under the name is gone.

name: Banner Lobby Background
subtitle: Your banner is your lobby background
desc: The banner you pick in your profile is now the background of the lobby and the Match, Offline and Online menus.

name: Sign In With Google
subtitle: Save your progress to your Google account
desc: Configure now has SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE. Sign in to save your progress to your Google account and load it on any phone or computer.

name: Settings + Downloads
subtitle: Gear button, MIN or FULL download
desc: Adds a settings button at the top right of the lobby with Sign in with Google, MIN download and FULL download. Sign in with Google leaves Configure. The first start asks MIN or FULL and keeps using it until it is switched in Settings. MIN is small, voices load while you play and quality stays LOW. FULL gets every voice file before the lobby opens and quality can go up to HIGH. Each update adds its new files. The game still needs the internet.

name: New Update Message
subtitle: Lobby players go back to the start screen
desc: When something is released, players in the lobby see NEW UPDATE with the names of what was released and go back to the start screen. Players in a match finish first and get it when they are back in the lobby. Releasing several at once from Dev Studio gives one message.

name: User ID
subtitle: Top right of the lobby, hidden until tapped
desc: Shows USER ID at the top right of the lobby. It starts hidden. Tap it to show the id and tap again to hide it.

name: Connecting
subtitle: Start screen says connecting for 8 seconds
desc: When you tap start, the bottom of the start screen says CONNECTING TO COMBO for 8 seconds, then the game carries on.

name: Cover Server Wake-Up
subtitle: Intro and start screen show while the server wakes
desc: The game keeps a copy of its own files on your device. When the game server is still waking up, the studio intro and start screen show right away, and the start screen keeps saying CONNECTING TO COMBO past 8 seconds until the server answers. Needs the Connecting update.

name: Latest Game Icon
subtitle: Newest released icon is always the game icon
desc: When an update adds a new game icon, the game icon changes to it as soon as the update is released, also for players who have the game open. If more than one icon update is out, the one released last is used.

name: Both Look At Camera
subtitle: The other fighter turns to the camera too
desc: When a fighter is shown facing the camera, the fighter they are facing turns to the camera too. Works in story cutscenes, match intros, ultimates and win shots.

name: Settings On Start Screen
subtitle: Settings button moves out of the lobby
desc: The settings button is removed from the lobby and sits at the top right of the start screen. Needs the Settings + Downloads update.

name: User ID On Start Screen
subtitle: Top left of the start screen, hidden until tapped
desc: Shows USER ID at the top left of the start screen. It starts hidden. Tap it to show the id and tap again to hide it.

name: Full Face Icons
subtitle: Character icons zoomed out
desc: Every character face icon is zoomed out so the whole head shows, with hair, ears and horns inside the picture.

name: Download Only On Big Releases
subtitle: Players download only when 5 or more go out at once
desc: Players on FULL download are only sent to the download screen when 5 or more things are released at once. Smaller releases load while you play.

name: Small MIN Download
subtitle: MIN downloads the fight sounds only
desc: MIN download now has a small download of its own: only the fight shouts and pain sounds. Everything else still loads while you play. FULL is unchanged.

name: 2.5D Backgrounds
subtitle: More depth on every map, story place and menu
desc: Maps in matches and story get two more depth layers on the ground: stage props just behind the fighters and dark props close to the camera, which slide at their own speed when the camera moves. Story scenes get a slow camera drift. Menu screens get a floor that runs toward you.

name: Character Artwork
subtitle: Every fighter has their own art
desc: Every fighter now has their own artwork, with their own pose and backdrop design. It shows on the lobby, the fighter detail screen, team cards and the summon reveal.

name: Team Leader Background
subtitle: Lobby background is your first fighter
desc: The lobby background is now the first fighter of your team and their world, instead of your profile banner. The fighter picture on the right side of the lobby is removed.

name: Square Menu Buttons
subtitle: Lobby and match buttons are square tiles
desc: The big buttons on the lobby and on the Match, Offline and Online screens are now square tiles in a grid. They do the same things as before.

name: Lobby Tab 2
subtitle: Challenges, Leaderboard and Dev Studio as squares
desc: The lobby buttons now have two tabs. Tab 1 has Story, Match, Gacha, Teams, Friends and Configure. Tab 2 has Challenges and Leaderboard as square tiles. Needs the Square Menu Buttons update.

name: Download Game Files
subtitle: Downloads always fetch the game's own files too
desc: The download screen now also fetches the game's own updated files, on both FULL and MIN, plus any new voice files. A big release always shows the download, and the game restarts itself at the end if its files changed.

name: First-Time Settings
subtitle: Settings shows only sign-in before the first download
desc: The first time you open the game, Settings on the start screen only shows Sign in with Google. Tap start afterwards to choose MIN or FULL download.

name: View Fighters On Profiles
subtitle: Hold a fighter on someone's profile
desc: On another player's profile, hold one of their three fighters to open that fighter in full view with that player's level and stars.

name: Fighters Talk
subtitle: Tap a fighter's art to hear them
desc: On a fighter's full view, tap their art and they say a line. Each fighter has two lines and taps switch between them.

name: Fighters Talk: No Bubble
subtitle: Voice only when you tap a fighter
desc: When you tap a fighter's art they only talk out loud. The speech bubble is removed.

name: Combo Shout
subtitle: The start screen fighters shout COMBO together
desc: When the start screen shows, the two fighters on it shout COMBO at the same time, matched to the same length, and then the music starts. Every fighter has a COMBO shout in their own voice. In English, or in Japanese when VOICES is set to Japanese.

name: Download Screen Art
subtitle: Full-screen fighter art and tips while you download
desc: The download screens are now a full-screen picture of a fighter with a tip on it. MIN and FULL are at the top, the download bar is at the bottom, and arrows at the middle left and right flip through 20 arts and tips.

name: Loading Screen Beat
subtitle: A scary water drop beat while you load
desc: The loading screens play a scary beat: slow heartbeat thuds, a low drone and echoing water drops. It plays on the choose download screen, while downloading, and on the online match loading screen.

name: Download After Connecting
subtitle: Downloads only start after you tap start
desc: A download never starts from Settings on the start screen any more. Picking MIN or FULL there saves your choice, and the download screen shows after you tap start and CONNECTING has finished, the same as the first time you open the game.

name: Combo Update Message
subtitle: The update message just says COMBO UPDATE
desc: When something is released, the message on the start screen only says COMBO UPDATE. The names of what was released are not listed.

name: Studio Intro: No Music
subtitle: Music starts after the COMBO shout
desc: No music plays during the Treyyverse studio intro. The start screen music only starts after the fighters shout COMBO.

name: News: One Post Per Release
subtitle: Things released together share one news post
desc: When several things are released together, they show as one news post that lists all of them. Its picture shows the new stages, fighters and banners one at a time and switches every 4 seconds.

name: News Pictures
subtitle: Update posts show a picture
desc: Update posts in the NEWS now show a picture of what changed.

name: News Picture Arrows
subtitle: Arrows instead of auto switching
desc: In a news post with several pictures, the picture no longer changes by itself. Use the arrows on its left and right to see the next one.

name: Summon Duel
subtitle: Kenko and Neto fight for your pull
desc: The summon animation is now a duel. Kenko and Neto face off, fight, and you press FINISH. If Kenko's ultimate lands, better odds for higher rarity. If Neto dodges and finishes her, lower odds. If they trade one punch and walk away, normal odds. Each has an equal chance. The winner gets the aura of your best pull.

name: Summon Duel: Voices And Close-Ups
subtitle: Face-off shots, voices, raised hand ending
desc: The summon duel now opens like a cutscene: Kenko stands with her back to us and Neto faces the camera. Both fighters speak during the duel, and the winner raises a hand in the aura at the end.

name: COMBO Shout On Tap
subtitle: They shout when you tap start
desc: The two fighters on the start screen now shout COMBO when you tap start, instead of when the start screen appears.

name: No Guaranteed Fighter
subtitle: Every pull uses the normal odds
desc: The guaranteed new fighter on every 5th summon is removed. Every pull now uses the banner's odds, and the summon duel can raise or lower them.

name: Even Banners
subtitle: Rate-up fighters are 5 in 100 on every banner
desc: Every banner now gives its rate-up fighters the same chance: 5 summons in 100. No banner gives more duplicates than another, even a one-fighter banner. The other pulls use the normal odds.

name: Low Attacks
subtitle: Attack while crouched
desc: You can now attack while crouched. Light gives a low attack and heavy gives a low heavy. Every fighter has their own pair: a low kick, low jab or double palm, and a sweep, rising uppercut or slide kick.

name: Own Attack Moves
subtitle: Different light and heavy attacks per fighter
desc: Every fighter now has their own light attack chain and heavy attack: jabs, crosses, kicks, elbows, knees, hooks and more. Damage and speed are the same as before.

name: Own Jumps And Blocks
subtitle: Different jump and block styles per fighter
desc: Fighters now jump and block in their own way. There are five jump styles, including a tuck and a front flip, and five block styles.

name: Living Idle Poses
subtitle: Own stance, looking around, small moves
desc: Every fighter now stands in their own stance and feels alive: they shift their weight, look around and make small moves like rolling their shoulders or bouncing.

name: Download On 4
subtitle: Players download when 4 or more go out at once
desc: The download screen now comes up when 4 or more things are released at once, instead of 5.

name: News For New Players
subtitle: New players only get the latest news
desc: A new player no longer gets all the old news. They get the last post from before they started, and everything after it.

name: Clash Close-Up
subtitle: Cutscene shot after a clash
desc: After a clash in a match, the two fighters talk in a cutscene-style shot: your fighter stands with their back to you and the other fighter faces the camera. Then it is back to the battle.

name: Gold Tab
subtitle: Icons, banners and borders cost gold tickets
desc: Everyone's profile icons, banners and borders are reset. You now get them in the GOLD tab of the gacha by summoning with gold tickets. There are four gold banners: ICONS for 5, BANNERS for 10, BORDERS for 15 and ALL for 10, each with SUMMON ×1 and ×10. Each summon gives a random one you do not own. The banner picture shows its top 4, one at a time, changing every 4 seconds. Summons with gems and red tickets no longer give them.

name: Gold Banners Mix
subtitle: Four mixed gold banners, no exchange shop
desc: The four gold banners now all give a mix. Each summon costs 5 gold tickets. Half of the summons give EXP items (SMALL EXP ×10 or BIG EXP ×2), the other half give a random profile banner or icon border you do not own. Each gold banner has its own top 4. The exchange shop is removed. Icons come with the fighter again: every fighter you summon gives its icon.

name: 50 Anime Borders
subtitle: All old icon borders replaced
desc: All the old icon borders are gone. There are 50 new anime style borders: 25 still and 25 animated, with things like cat ears, auras, lightning, falling petals and spirit orbs. Everyone starts again with the first one and gets the rest from the gold banners.

name: 50 Anime Banners
subtitle: All old profile banners replaced
desc: All the old profile banners are gone. There are 50 new anime style banners: 25 still and 25 animated. Some show fighters doing something, some show a power, some show both. Everyone starts again with the first one and gets the rest from the gold banners.

name: Banners Remade
subtitle: A new set of 50 anime banners
desc: The 50 profile banners are remade. The new set has big close shots: a fighter up close, a fighter from behind looking at the view, two fighters face to face, a full move, a team of three, or a power alone. 25 are still and 25 are animated. The ones you own carry over by number.

name: Border Pages
subtitle: All 50 icon borders fit in the list
desc: The ICON BORDERS list in your profile now has pages with a page counter, 30 borders per page, so all 50 new borders can be seen and picked.

name: Match Drops
subtitle: No gold tab, no exchange shop, no gold tickets
desc: The GOLD tab, the exchange shop and gold tickets are gone. Winning a match in any mode has a 1 in 2 chance to drop EXP. Winning a Boss Raid or a Ranked match has a 1 in 4 chance to drop a profile banner or an icon border you do not own. You never get a repeat, only EXP can repeat.

name: Always Up To Date
subtitle: Open games load new updates by themselves
desc: A game that is already open now reloads by itself when new game files are out, the next time you are on the start screen or in the lobby. Before, a new update did nothing until you closed the game and opened it again.

name: Dev Key In Settings
subtitle: DEV KEY moves to the start screen
desc: The DEV KEY button is now in SETTINGS on the start screen, next to CLOSE. It is no longer in Configure inside the game.

name: Dev Studio In Settings
subtitle: Dev Studio opens from DEV KEY only
desc: The DEV STUDIO button is gone from the lobby and the dev option is gone from Configure. The only way in is SETTINGS on the start screen: once the key is in, pressing DEV KEY opens the Dev Studio.

name: Sound Stays
subtitle: Sound comes back when you return to the game
desc: When you leave the game but keep the tab and come back, the sound comes back. Before, the sound could stay off after returning.

name: No Lobby User ID
subtitle: USER ID is only on the start screen
desc: The USER ID line is removed from the lobby. It is still at the top left of the start screen.

name: Duel Decides Rarity
subtitle: The summon duel sets what you can pull
desc: The summon duel now decides the rarity. If you lose, every pull is R. If it is a draw, you get SR and lower. If you win, you get SSR and lower, with a chance of UR on ticket banners. A summon of 10 can give several of the top rarity and anything lower.

name: Quiet Dev Studio
subtitle: No music in the Dev Studio, BACK goes to start
desc: The Dev Studio has no music. Leaving it takes you back to the start screen, and tapping start connects you as usual.

name: Subtitles Only
subtitle: No talk box in cutscenes
desc: The talk boxes are gone. In cutscenes the speaker's face shows with no square around it, next to their name and the words, with no rectangle behind them. The lines fighters say before and after a match also lose their rectangle and keep the name and the words.

name: Custom Mobile Layout
subtitle: Move, resize and fade the touch buttons
desc: You can make your own button layout on mobile. Go to CONFIGURE, CONTROLS, MOBILE and tap CUSTOM LAYOUT. Drag any button where you want it, then change its size and how see-through it is. RESET puts everything back.
